purpose: S3 bucket for incident artifacts/exports (docs/19-aws-strategy.md Phase 5, docs/24-aws-prerequisites-setup-guide.md Phase 4) -- backs IncidentReportExportService.
public_access: fully blocked (BlockPublicAcls, IgnorePublicAcls, BlockPublicPolicy, RestrictPublicBuckets all true) -- nothing in this project needs public object access

application_iam_user.name: incidentcommand-s3-dev
application_iam_user.scope: s3:PutObject + s3:GetObject on bucket objects, s3:ListBucket on the bucket itself -- this bucket only, not account-wide S3 access
application_iam_user.note: Deliberately separate from incidentcommand-ec2-dev -- each service gets its own minimally-scoped credential, not one shared application user.

local_dev_config: Real bucket name + access key already filled into backend/.env (gitignored, never committed) -- see backend/.env.example for the template.
